juce_add_plugin(LTQuasar
    PRODUCT_NAME "LT QUASAR"
    COMPANY_NAME "LT Audio"
    BUNDLE_ID com.ltaudio.quasar
    PLUGIN_MANUFACTURER_CODE Ltau
    PLUGIN_CODE Ltqs
    FORMATS ${LT_PLUGIN_FORMATS}
    IS_SYNTH TRUE
    NEEDS_MIDI_INPUT TRUE
    NEEDS_MIDI_OUTPUT FALSE
    IS_MIDI_EFFECT FALSE
    EDITOR_WANTS_KEYBOARD_FOCUS TRUE
    VST3_CATEGORIES Instrument Synth
    AU_MAIN_TYPE kAudioUnitType_MusicDevice
    ICON_BIG ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/shared/brand/icon-quasar.png
    COPY_PLUGIN_AFTER_BUILD FALSE)

# factory banks (JSON, generated by tools/quasar/make_banks.py)
file(GLOB QUASAR_BANKS CONFIGURE_DEPENDS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Resources/banks/*.json)
juce_add_binary_data(QuasarData HEADER_NAME QuasarData.h NAMESPACE QuasarData SOURCES ${QUASAR_BANKS})

set(QUASAR_ENGINE_SOURCES_LIST
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Source/Params.cpp
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Source/ModDefs.cpp
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Source/FxTypes.cpp
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Source/Wavetables.cpp
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Source/SampleData.cpp
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Source/LfoShape.cpp
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Source/SynthEngine.cpp
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Source/Reverb.cpp
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Source/Fx.cpp
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Source/Presets.cpp
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/plugins/nova/Source/NovaEngine.cpp
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/plugins/orbit/Source/OrbitEngine.cpp)
set(QUASAR_ENGINE_SOURCES ${QUASAR_ENGINE_SOURCES_LIST})
set(QUASAR_ENGINE_SOURCES ${QUASAR_ENGINE_SOURCES_LIST} PARENT_SCOPE)
set(QUASAR_INCLUDES
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Source
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/plugins/nova/Source
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/plugins/orbit/Source
    PARENT_SCOPE)

target_sources(LTQuasar PRIVATE
    ${QUASAR_ENGINE_SOURCES}
    Source/PluginProcessor.cpp
    Source/PluginEditor.cpp
    Source/Widgets.cpp
    Source/Pages.cpp
    Source/Browser.cpp)

target_include_directories(LTQuasar PRIVATE
    Source
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/plugins/nova/Source
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/plugins/orbit/Source)

target_compile_definitions(LTQuasar PUBLIC JUCE_VST3_CAN_REPLACE_VST2=0)
target_link_libraries(LTQuasar PRIVATE QuasarData lt_dsp juce::juce_audio_utils juce::juce_dsp)
lt_configure_target(LTQuasar)
